svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.52k stars in total, about 1.93k a year earlier. jactionlint 354, mr boxington 788, aube 2078, fnox 2418, hk 1354, pitchfork 722, usage 1082, +5 more 722.
